svg.title: Mind Map Studio: a quick tour
svg.desc: A looping highlight reel in six scenes after a title card. 1: a map is built from the keyboard: Tab adds the branch Hiring, which lands on the left, Tab and Enter add Designer and Engineer, and Alt+Shift+F flips Hiring to the other side. 2: the same project in the Outline view, where Enter adds Bundles, then the Brainstorm, then Split view with the Brainstorm beside the Outline. 3: rich nodes: a branch gets the role theme, a colour and a 🎯 marker, #p1 #pricing typed while renaming become tags, Ctrl+Enter ticks the last task (3/3), and Ctrl+V pastes a picture. 4: F5 presents the map on a dark stage: the centre, then each branch clockwise, then into them, with earlier steps dimmed and a step counter. 5: the install icon in the address bar installs the app in its own window; offline, a node is still added and saved on this device. 6: a project syncs through a folder to another computer, and an AI assistant gets a packet and sends back a map that is put into the project.

g.text: Tab adds a child, Enter a sibling; Alt+Shift+F flips a branch to the other side.
The map as a canvas or an outline, a Brainstorm for quick ideas, or two side by side.
Roles, colours, markers, tasks, #tags and pictures on any node.
The centre, then each branch clockwise, then into them. Earlier steps dim.
Your projects stay on your device: no account, no server.
No API key: the app never
Sync and AI, on your terms
Sync through a folder you choose. Hand an AI assistant a file; no API key.
